purpose: Provenance for the packaged workflow notebook. Nothing reads this file: it is a record for a maintainer, not an enforced invariant. An earlier revision of it listed a per-cell sha256 for each template cell; those digests matched no cell under any scheme the notebook's own text implies, so they were removed rather than left behind looking verified. Recomputing them would not help either, because a digest cannot tell an intended deviation from an accidental edit; the deviations list below can.

generated_from.note: The packaged example notebook of the two-donor lung-tissue study described in config/examples/README.md. The template cells were derived from it by washing data-source-specific content out; the deviations are listed below and are not limited to the digest of any single cell.
generated_from.note_on_counts: The packaged example has one more cell than the pre-washing source it came from: an inserted bilingual warning that the reviewed cluster-to-cell-type mapping must never be transplanted.

documented_deviations: The parameter cell reads a JSON sidecar named by SCMO_SCANPY_PARAMETERS instead of project literals.
read_10x_zip becomes read_10x_matrix with 10x_mtx and 10x_h5 branches; the ZIP branch is preserved.
The cohort label is the configured cell_id_prefix, so RNA cell IDs match ALLC cell IDs downstream.
The unused marker_genes lineage dictionary is not carried over; panels come from configuration.
Panels, the reviewed cluster mapping and focus-cluster lists are injected; an empty panel makes the candidate branch emit data-driven evidence instead of score-based proposals.
The candidate directory guard honours overwrite_data_outputs so an interrupted run can resume in the same run directory.
Sample palette, mitochondrial and ribosomal prefixes, target sum and HVG batch key are injected.
The input presence check accepts a directory (10x_mtx) and reports the input format; the source notebook only read ZIPs.
The ZIP branch rejects absolute members and members containing `..` before extracting.
Focus dotplots are skipped unless their panel and cluster lists are configured.
The save cell writes notebook_artifacts.json so the harness records evidence without re-deriving filenames.
Cell 1 selects the inline matplotlib backend so the executed notebook carries the figures of the run; the runner executes headlessly.
Cell sources are re-chunked to one JSON entry per line; the rendered code text is unchanged.
